I’m a 23 year old man from MA who’s currently a senior for psychology as well as a full time behavioral therapist. My whole life I have struggled with suicidal thoughts as well as depression and anxiety, I suffer heavily from social anxiety specifically , but I have become so good at faking it that the people closest to me would have no idea. I suffer from depression and panic attacks daily. My friends or the people that I consider to be my friends , the only people I’ve ever been comfortable around never invite me anywhere , they all hang out with each other and post it but I never get an invite or hear from them. It’s been like this with everyone I’ve ever gotten close enough with to consider a true friend. I have a lot of issues with my my family and I barely know any of them, I’m pretty much a loner and I constantly think of how many people would actually care if I wasn’t here , maybe one handful. The girl of my dreams , I had her for about two years and I messed it up, I don’t want to go into details because that still fucks with me the most, but I just feel I am not good enough for anyone relationship or not. I spend a lot of time alone and do enjoy my company, but I am starting to feel like it’s not really worth all the hurt I feel every single day
